# Case 51: Single-section shares forced into the body band
Skill: write-experiments
Expected gates: G-STY-rhythm, G-SH-R
Language: en
Snippet:
> Only Section V was drafted. Its share of sentences over 35 words was 4%, below the body band of 7%-13%. To raise it, the setup paragraph now defines the feasibility rate in three sentences of 9, 10, and 11 words and lists the population size, the generations, and the runs in separate sentences. The remaining flag appears as a bracketed comment in the manuscript.
Why it fails: the 90th percentile and the two shares apply to a whole paper, so one section is checked against its section mean only, splitting definition and list sentences creates a run of short sentences, and the flag and its reason belong in the delivery note.
